title: Shopper Earnings Terms — Cashout-Fee Credit on Cartwise Shopper Batches Mileage Adjustments
content:
**Condition.** When a mileage adjustment is approved on a Cartwise Shopper Batches batch, a cashout-fee credit is added after the claimed amount has been multiplied by any share applying to it. The credit reads the instant cashout fees charged on the shopper's payout account in Cartwise Shopper Payouts in less than one whole calendar month before the handling date:

(a) **1.00** when those fees total **1.00 or more**;

(b) **0.50** when they total **more than zero and less than 1.00**;

(c) **nothing** when none was charged.

## Boundaries (hypothetical fee histories)

| Instant cashout fees charged less than one whole calendar month before handling | Total | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| Two fees of 0.50 | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| One fee of 0.50 | 0.50 | 0.50 |
| Three fees of 0.50 | 1.50 | 1.00 |
| None (the last fee was charged two months ago) | 0.00 | Nothing |

Only fees charged on instant cashouts count, and only those within the period stated.
